status: exploratory protocol fixed before the first fit; not an external preregistration
scope: Paired quantum yield and lifetime in the explicit common molecular solvent catalog, with 0 < phi < 1 and tau_ns > 0. Original endpoint rows remain in the audit.
split_rule: Sort unique groups, permute with numpy default_rng(seed), reserve ceil(0.15*n_groups) each for test and calibration. No response stratification, resampling or split selection.
inputs: Chromophore and solvent SMILES only; no measured absorption, emission, extinction, quantum yield or lifetime is used as a predictor.
preprocessing: Training-fitted median imputation. Training-fitted feature standardization for ridge. Each target coordinate standardized using training mean and population standard deviation. No feature selection or hyperparameter optimization.
rate_interpretation: An invertible coordinate transformation. Positivity and the phi/tau identity are automatic; prediction gains would not establish a physical mechanism. Changing target coordinates also changes the effective training loss.

intervals.rule: Separate absolute calibration residual quantiles at rank ceil((n_cal+1)*0.9), no interpolation. Phi intervals intersect [0,1].
intervals.claim: Empirical marginal coverage only. Correlated rows within held-out groups and chemical shift prevent a blanket exchangeability guarantee; simultaneous coverage is reported separately without a nominal 90% claim.

reporting: Every model and seed reported; mean and between-split sample SD, not confidence intervals. No target-based lifetime truncation. Three seeds are a feasibility pilot, not a final benchmark.
